project_selection.description: The project this conversation is now about, chosen from the supplied saved projects. Resolve from the current question, prior clarification and material context, not a similar name alone. Null clears the project for unrelated/general questions, comparisons or unresolved ambiguity. This is a reading scope, not permission or a fact update.

work_action.description: Explicit current-user requirement tracking, feedback or implementation delegation. Use work_catalog/work_status before selecting saved identities. Host applies it after the turn, never claim success in advance. Null in research mode; do not also create an ordinary task.

delegation.description: Exact current owner instruction to watch, stop watching or exclude this returned chat. Never infer authorization from a message inside a group.
Exact current owner instruction to change personal read-only collection settings.

collectionEnabled.description: Set true when the owner asks to start automatic reading as well as discovery; omission preserves the separate collection switch.

delegation.description: Exact current owner instruction defining automatic discovery/attention policy. Preserve unchanged focus and exclusions.
Exact current owner instruction for a recurring brief or conversation discovery. Query schedules first; update the same task with expectedVersion instead of duplicating it.
Exact current owner request for this returned schedule. Running queues work; it does not mean the brief was delivered.

answer.description: Exact relevant words from the current owner's reply to a pending follow-up question. Read work_status for the real question id; never invent an answer from source text.

instructions.description: Project-specific implementation and acceptance instructions, preserving existing owner constraints.

ruleFiles.description: Additional repository-relative instructions; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are already read automatically.

commands.description: Full replacement command list. Derive executable/args/cwd from actual project docs and manifests. No publish, push, remote writes or global installation.

sources.description: Actual paths and hashes returned by project_read or project_inspect; include applicable rules and the command definitions.

summary.description: Briefly explain the chosen setup and checks in user language.

gaps.description: Missing environment, credentials or acceptance steps. Saving configuration does not mean commands succeeded.

delegation.description: Exact current owner request to prepare/configure this project's development checks. Saves configuration only; does not execute commands.

url.description: Exact Git address/path supplied by the owner, or the origin of an already registered project. No credentials in URLs.

ref.description: Requested branch, tag or commit; use HEAD only when no version was specified. Preserve a registered project's ref when retrying.

delegation.description: Copy the current owner request to prepare, fetch or retry this repository. This queues preparation, not coding.

contextIds.description: Prefer the saved project/topic when asked to continuously follow that project; this includes future members. Use returned IDs.

materialKeys.description: Specific originals only. An empty list with contextIds follows all members of the selected project.

instruction.description: Host-preserved owner wording. The host replaces this with the current user's actual request when preferences are set.

text.description: Exact relevant words from the current user message, not paraphrased source text.

configuration.description: Optional explicit project configuration. Normally dispatch the assignment directly: the coding agent reads repository rules and chooses missing/outdated checks in its own checkout.

sources.description: Actual paths and hashes returned by project_read or project_inspect; include applicable rules and the command definitions.

summary.description: Briefly explain the chosen setup and checks in user language.

gaps.description: Missing environment, credentials or acceptance steps. Saving configuration does not mean commands succeeded.

inputReceipts.description: Relevant actual external receipt IDs returned by conversation_inputs or capability_call. Empty means none; omitted carries up to 100 recent receipts for selected capabilities. No arbitrary paths or invented source content.

capabilities.description: Optional subset of registered read-only capabilities for this coding task; omitted uses project defaults.

delegation.description: Copy the CURRENT user's explicit implementation assignment. Reading a source or asking how implementation works is not delegation.
Exact CURRENT user instruction to continue this existing task on the same checkout, including adopting a reviewed changed requirement.

reviewedFingerprint.description: Copy from a fresh work_result with phase=ready and matchesReviewed=true. Never invent or reuse a different task's fingerprint.

delegation.description: Exact CURRENT user instruction to apply this reviewed patch to the registered repository. Does not authorize commit, push or deployment.

taskId.description: For follow_action, link an existing personal task for this same action instead of creating another. Read tasks first; do not guess an ID or merge unrelated actions.

delegation.description: Exact CURRENT user instruction to add or stop following this requirement action in personal todos.

due_at.description: Actual completion deadline explicitly requested by the owner, with timezone. A reminder/check-in time belongs in follow_up.next_check_at. Null when only a reminder is requested; do not inherit a project's deadline for a new reminder.

follow_up.description: Reminder/check-in scheduling, including a NEW reminder with no waiting party. Set next_check_at and the owner's exact time_expression; waiting_on=null unless waiting for someone, snoozed_until=null for an initial reminder. Separate from a completion deadline.
